description: Unit tests for IndexV2Updater class, testing index update scenarios, concurrency, and error handling in the org.fdroid.index.v2 package.

classes.name: IndexV2UpdaterTest
classes.description: Test class for IndexV2Updater, includes setup, multiple test cases for index update logic, concurrency, and error scenarios.

methods.name: createDb
methods.description: Initializes the database before each test.

methods.name: testFullIndexEmptyToMin
methods.description: Tests updating from an empty index to minimum version.

methods.name: testFullIndexEmptyToMid
methods.description: Tests updating from an empty index to mid version.

methods.name: testFullIndexEmptyToMax
methods.description: Tests updating from an empty index to maximum version.

methods.name: testDiffMinToMid
methods.description: Tests diff update from min to mid index.

methods.name: testDiffEmptyToMin
methods.description: Tests diff update from empty to min index.

methods.name: testDiffMidToMax
methods.description: Tests diff update from mid to max index.

methods.name: testSameTimestampUnchanged
methods.description: Verifies no update occurs if timestamps are unchanged.

methods.name: testHigherTimestampUnchanged
methods.description: Verifies no update occurs if new index has higher timestamp.

methods.name: testNoDiffFoundIndexFallback
methods.description: Tests fallback when no diff is found.

methods.name: testWrongFingerprint
methods.description: Tests error handling for wrong fingerprint.

methods.name: testV1ToV2ForcesFullUpdateEvenIfDiffExists
methods.description: Ensures full update when upgrading from v1 to v2.

methods.name: concurrentUpdateTest
methods.description: Tests concurrent index updates and transaction handling.

methods.name: prepareUpdate
methods.description: Prepares test data and mocks for index update tests.

methods.name: noError
methods.description: Helper to throw error if IndexUpdateResult is an error.
